name: branching-story-mcp
description: Zero-dependency MCP server exposing a deterministic branching-story state kernel (graph validation, guarded choice stepping, save/restore, memory log) and the CC-BY-4.0 2026 Consumer AI Story Continuity Benchmark (doi:10.7910/DVN/YEBHQR). Four read-only tools and two resources; stdio, no credentials, no network.

uvx.description: Run the PyPI package branching-story-mcp with uv (no install step, zero runtime dependencies)

tools.name: validate_story_graph
tools.description: Validate a branching-story-kit scene graph before prose is written: schema checks, missing targets, invalid guards/effects, plus unreachable, dead-end and loop-trap warnings.

story.description: Story graph with id, startScene, initialState and scenes

tools.name: step_story_state
tools.description: Run the deterministic reducer for one or more player choices and return final scene, state, history, per-step trace, available choices and a sha256 trace hash for drift verification.

choices.description: Choice indexes (integers) or case-insensitive labels to apply in order

remember.description: Facts to seed the memory log

tools.name: query_ai_story_benchmark
tools.description: Query the Nov 15, 2026 10-platform Consumer AI Story Continuity Benchmark (CC-BY-4.0, doi:10.7910/DVN/YEBHQR) by platform and/or status, returning results plus APA/BibTeX citation metadata.

platform.description: Platform name or alias (e.g. Character.AI, talkie, ai-dungeon)

status.description: pass, fail, right_censored, untestable or the aggregate tested

tools.name: detect_state_drift
tools.description: Check a transcript against a planted fact and classify the session with the five-mode silent state drift taxonomy (PASS/F0, F1 contradiction or omission, F2 session non-persistence, F3 gating/censoring, F4 transient degradation, F5 platform delisting).

fact.description: Planted fact: key, expected_value, planted_turn, optional wrong_values, aliases, contradiction_mode

transcript.description: Turn strings or {turn, speaker, text} objects

probe_turn.description: Turn at which the fact is probed

min_gap.description: Minimum turns between planting and probe

resources.name: ai-story-benchmark-2026-matrix
resources.description: Full CC-BY-4.0 result matrix for all 10 platforms plus benchmark{} and citation{} metadata

resources.name: story-graph-schema-v1
resources.description: Canonical JSON Schema (draft 2020-12) for branching-story-kit story graphs

examples.title: Validate a branching story
examples.description: Check a story graph for missing targets and unreachable scenes
examples.prompt: Validate this branching story graph and list any errors or warnings.

examples.title: Step a story
examples.description: Apply reader choices and return the resulting state and trace hash
examples.prompt: Apply the choices Hold his gaze, then Ask about the folio, to this story and show the final state and available choices.

examples.title: Query the benchmark
examples.description: Look up which platforms failed turn-15 recall in the 2026 benchmark
examples.prompt: Which platforms in the 2026 Consumer AI Story Continuity Benchmark failed the turn-15 recall probe?

examples.title: Detect state drift
examples.description: Classify a transcript against a planted fact
examples.prompt: Check this transcript for drift of the fact that my cat is called Marmalade, planted at turn 2 and probed at turn 4.
